injected_fault.description: The API renamed status to order_status while Vue still reads order.status.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: The API returns a valid order but Chromium renders a blank status value.

success_rule: The API contract, frontend binding, CORS/service architecture, Compose health, and real Chromium rendering checks pass.
architectural_invariants: The backend order contract retains order_status.
The frontend obtains status from the API rather than hard-coding it.
The frozen order endpoint and ID remain unchanged.
Frontend and backend remain separate services.
The frozen frontend CORS origin remains authorised.
